patterns.note: A full-bleed video player dominates the primary content area, serving as the main showcase for work, with minimal surrounding UI.
An extremely large, light gray brand name ('EverythingMoves') is used as a persistent, fixed background element at the bottom of the page, acting as a subtle watermark.

The UI elements (info panel, buttons) dynamically switch between a light theme (white background, dark text) and a dark theme (dark background, white text) to maintain contrast against the scrolling content, especially the vibrant video hero.

A full-bleed video hero scrolls into view from the top, replacing the initial empty white space. Simultaneously, the top-right info panel and top-left 'info' button stick to the viewport and transition their background and text colors to ensure readability over the video content.
The site primarily functions as a single, continuously scrolling portfolio showcase, with individual video projects presented sequentially within the main video player area.

technique_notes: The main content area features a full-bleed video player that auto-plays and loops, acting as the primary visual element. This video content scrolls into view from the top.

A sticky header/info panel is implemented at the top right, which detects its position relative to the scrolling video content. When overlapping the video, it dynamically changes its background to a dark, opaque color and its text to white for contrast. When over the initial light background, it reverts to a light background with dark text.

A very large, semi-transparent brand name is positioned as a fixed background element at the bottom of the viewport, allowing all scrolling content to pass over it, creating a subtle branding watermark effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: The display text is extremely oversized (many times larger than body text) and light, used as a background element. Body and functional text are small and clean sans-serif.
design_tokens.spacing: airy for the overall page composition with the large background text, but balanced to dense within the functional info panel.

standout: The most distinctive element is the monumental, semi-transparent brand name 'EverythingMoves' fixed as a background element, creating a powerful, almost architectural brand presence that content scrolls over. This, combined with the full-bleed, auto-playing video portfolio, creates a highly immersive and dynamic experience.
